_stamp: [2026-10-27 06:45 PM Johnny Chu - Chu Hoàng Anh] PHASE-0.143 S143-L5 (D143-8…12) — 'Lưu vào kho tri thức': ONE pool .md per notebook in the Kho tri thức, one entries[] property + one body section per save. Code: BizCity_Twin_Vault::append (REST POST bizcity-vault/v1/note/append, MCP vault.append). Runtime JSON; docs/ is never read at runtime.

answer_md.note: the answer as the assistant wrote it; [nb:X/pY] tokens are kept

message_id.note: the answering message; the same id saved twice is ONE entry (idempotency vault-append:<blog>:<nb>:<message_id>)

folder.note: number or name; required on the notebook's FIRST save, else error vault_pool_folder_needed (409) with suggest[]

output.journal_entry_id: integer (the `learn` row; 0 when the Journal is absent or the save was a duplicate)

pool_file.entries: one JSON object per line under `entries:` (valid YAML flow map; the vault YAML subset has no list-of-maps). Entry = {id, q, saved_at, by, source_ref, anchor, cites[], idem}
pool_file.body: intro, then one block per save: '## <q> {#<entry id>}', the answer, '**Nguồn:** [nb:X/pY] …', a stamp line. Newest at the bottom.
pool_file.rollover: the 201st save goes to '<slug>-2.md' (…-9.md); notebooks.settings.vault_pool.path follows
guards: vault.move keeps entries[] and the notebook's settings.vault_pool.folder follows

side_effects.journal: first save: one `common.note` row for the file (via write); every save: one `learn` row, source_ref 'lib:<path>#<entry id>'
hooks: bizcity_kg_notebook_notes_pinned($notebook_id, $user_id, $journal_entry_id) — the skeleton keeps preferring saved answers
